function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values, and `sample_seq` indicates that some patients were re-tested (appearing twice). The documentation says to keep only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient.", "implication": "If we do not deduplicate, we will double-count re-tested patients — inflating the sample size and potentially biasing the mean if the second measurement differs from the first. This changes the analysis: we must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping the row with the highest `sample_seq`."}
function.name: note_finding
